overview.description: The ProShares S&P 500 Ex-Technology ETF (SPXT) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P 500 Ex-Information Technology index, a market-cap-weighted index of US large-cap stocks, excluding firms in the technology sector. SPXT was launched on Sep 22, 2015 and is issued by ProShares.

data.title: ProShares Reduces Fees for S&P 500 Ex-Sector ETFs
data.text: BETHESDA, Md.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--ProShares has lowered the fees on its suite of S&P 500 Ex-Sector ETFs, which allow investors to own the S&P 500 without an unwanted economic sector.

news.t: ProShares Reduces Fees for S&P 500 Ex-Sector ETFs

holdings.infoBox: SPXT is an equity ETF with a total of 430 individual holdings. The top holdings are Alphabet stock at 8.97%, Amazon.com at 6.03%, Meta Platforms at 4.06%, Tesla at 2.48%, and Eli Lilly and Company at 2.36%.
